name: atlas-planner
description: Plan University of Michigan schedules from Atlas: predicted grades, workload balance across semesters, premed/MCAT timing, instructor cross checks, walk times, and more.
long_description: Each user signs into Atlas with their own uniqname and Duo. Sessions, profiles and cached data stay on that user's computer and are never shared.

source.title: Data source
source.description: 'sample' for the built in test data, 'atlas' for live Atlas with your own login.
